data.habitat_ai: Warm-temperate deciduous and evergreen mixed broadleaved forests, along flood-disturbed streamsides, steep slopes, ravines, rocky outcrops, and cliff edges in mountainous regions
data.ecological_function_ai: Disturbance-adapted pioneer in streamside and slope environments; supports clonal persistence via basal and aerial sprouting; provides shade and habitat; seeds dispersed by animals and gravity; highly resilient to fire, drought, pollution, and harsh conditions
data.native_adapted_habitats_ai: Refugial populations in eastern (Mt. Tianmu), southern, and southwestern China (Mt. Dalou, Mt. Jinfo); adapted to urban pollution, compacted soils, drought, salt, and temperate to subtropical climates worldwide
data.agroforestry_use_cases_ai: Urban street and shade trees, park plantings, windbreaks, fruit/nut plantations in China, leaf harvest for medicine, ornamental landscapes, leaf mulch
data.general_description_ai: Sole extant species of ancient Ginkgoales gymnosperm; deciduous dioecious tree with distinctive fan-shaped leaves on long and short shoots; 20-35 m tall (up to 50+ m); living fossil with unchanged form for 170+ million years; brilliant yellow fall foliage; highly disease- and pest-resistant; extreme longevity
data.compatible_soil_types_ai: Deep, well-drained sandy loams, tolerant of sand, silt, clay, poor/infertile soils, urban compaction, salt; pH 4.5-8.5 (prefers 6.0-8.0); intolerant of waterlogging
data.growth_form_ai: Pyramidal to conical when young, broadening to oval or rounded crown with age; single straight trunk, ascending branches at 45 degrees
data.leaf_type_ai: Alternate, fan-shaped, 5-10 cm wide, bilobed or notched with dichotomous parallel venation; thicker on long shoots, clustered on short shoots; bright green turning deep golden-yellow in autumn
data.fruit_type_ai: Dioecious; females produce 1.5-2 cm apricot-like naked seeds with yellow-brown fleshy sarcotesta (foul-smelling butyric acid when rotting), hard inner shell
data.bark_characteristics_ai: Light gray to grayish-brown; shallow ridges/furrows when young, deeply furrowed, corky, and longitudinally fissured with age
data.lifespan_ai: Extremely long-lived, exceeding 1000 years commonly; no senescence evident up to 667+ years
data.stewardship_best_practices_ai: Full sun, well-drained sites; male cultivars to avoid messy fruit; low maintenance; drought tolerant once established; tolerant of pollution, salt, compaction
data.planting_recipes_ai: Plant spring or fall in full sun; well-drained soil; space 10-15 m apart; propagate by seed or grafting (males); avoid wet sites
data.pruning_maintenance_ai: Prune young trees to establish single central leader; minimal pruning required later; best in dormant season
data.disease_pest_management_ai: Highly resistant; rare issues include leaf blight (Alternaria, Pestalotiopsis), stem rot (Macrophomina on seedlings); manage with fungicides (carbendazim, thiophanate-methyl), shading, fertilization; few insect pests (e.g., defoliators)
data.fire_management_ai: Highly fire-resistant (low flammability, thick bark); survives crown fires via basal chichi/lignotubers sprouting; second lowest flammability among deciduous trees
data.cultural_significance_ai: Symbol of longevity, resilience, peace in China/Japan (temple plantings, Hiroshima survivors); traditional medicine (leaves for cognition/circulation, seeds edible); city tree (Tokyo, Seoul); featured in logos, ceremonies, cuisine
